title: Jordan's MRI shows dense white matter in the caudate and putamen

tellings.quote: really great research like I have a very unique codate and pudamin

plain: Jordan Jose says a brain scan showed unusually dense white matter in two structures deep in his brain, the caudate and the putamen. Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, tells Michels he has a "very unique" caudate and putamen, and connects this to research by the scientist Garry Nolan. If true, it would be a physical mark in his brain that sets him apart and might help explain why he was chosen.
